CheckTitle: Password lockout is enabled for general-user password policies
Description: Checks active password policies configure a positive lockout threshold.
Risk: No lockout threshold allows repeated online password guessing.

Code.Other:
1. In the Okta Admin Console, open the general-user password policy.
2. Edit lockout settings.
3. Set Lock out user after to a finite number of failed attempts.
4. Enable user notification or self-service unlock where appropriate.
5. Save and monitor failed sign-in and lockout events.

Recommendation.Text: Enable password lockout after a finite number of failed attempts to throttle online guessing.

Notes: Requires the Okta read scopes documented for the referenced management APIs.
